hubTitle.documents: Documents: online text and document tools
hubTitle.pdf: PDF: merge, split, and edit PDFs online
hubTitle.spreadsheet: Spreadsheet: online CSV and Excel tools

hubIntro.documents: The Documents category covers everyday writing and text tasks. Count the words in an essay or article, clean up text pasted from a PDF or Word file, change capitalization for variable names or titles, compare two drafts, or remove duplicate entries from a list. Your browser processes the text and nothing goes to a server, so you can use these tools on private or sensitive writing.
hubIntro.pdf: The PDF category handles everyday document jobs. Merge several files into one, split a long document into parts, shrink a file for email, rotate pages that came out upside down from a scan, pull out specific pages, or extract text. Your browser processes each file, so contracts and ID scans stay on your device.
hubIntro.spreadsheet: The Spreadsheet category handles everyday tabular data. View a CSV file without opening Excel, clean messy data, split a large file into parts, merge several files into one, or convert between CSV and Excel. Your browser processes each file and nothing reaches a server, so internal and sensitive data stays private.
hubIntro.data: The Data category holds conversion and cleanup tools for developers and analysts. Turn a JSON API response into a CSV table you can open in Excel, convert spreadsheet data into JSON for your code, work with legacy XML, or tidy and validate a data structure before you use it. The conversion runs in your browser, so sensitive and internal data stays with you.
hubIntro.productivity: The Productivity category has calculators for everyday operational work. Work out discounts and business margins, project a deadline in business days, find the exact difference between two dates, total working hours across several shifts, or add up time durations. Each calculation runs in your browser, so you don't need a separate spreadsheet app.

json-to-csv.schemaDescription: Converts JSON data to CSV format. Flattens nested structures into columns.
json-to-csv.title: JSON to CSV: convert JSON data to a CSV table
json-to-csv.lede: Paste your JSON. The CSV output appears right away, including nested JSON.
json-to-csv.featuresTitle: Why use this JSON to CSV tool?

features.title: Handles nested JSON
features.description: Objects inside objects become separate columns.

features.title: Automatic headers
features.description: Every column in your data lands in the header. No field gets skipped.

features.title: Direct download
features.description: Download the CSV as a file, ready to open in Excel or Sheets.

json-to-csv.howToTitle: How to convert JSON to CSV
steps: Paste your JSON data in the left column.
Watch the CSV result appear in the right column.
Click Copy to copy it, or Download to save it as a .csv file.
useCase: An API returns JSON, but your team needs to open it in Excel or Google Sheets for further analysis.
Developers use this conversion to check an API response as a table, easier to scan than raw JSON.

faq.question: Can nested JSON be converted?
faq.answer: Yes. The tool flattens nested objects into columns with combined names. { "address": { "city": "Bandung" } } becomes the column address.city. CSV has no concept of nesting, so flattening keeps your data intact.

faq.question: What happens when array items have different fields?
faq.answer: The tool combines every column found across your data into one header. Objects missing a field get an empty cell there.

faq.question: Does my JSON have to be an array?
faq.answer: No. A single object works too. The tool wraps it into one row automatically.

faq.question: Is my data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. The conversion runs in your browser from start to finish.

csv-to-json.seoDescription: Convert CSV to JSON instantly in your browser. Free, no file upload.
csv-to-json.schemaDescription: Converts CSV data to JSON format. The first row becomes the header.
csv-to-json.title: CSV to JSON: convert a CSV table to JSON
csv-to-json.lede: Paste your CSV data. The JSON output appears right away.
csv-to-json.featuresTitle: Why use this CSV to JSON tool?

features.title: Handles complex CSV
features.description: Fields with commas or quotes inside them still read correctly.

features.title: Clean JSON
features.description: The result comes pre-indented, ready to use right away.

features.title: Direct download
features.description: Download the JSON result as a .json file.

csv-to-json.howToTitle: How to convert CSV to JSON
steps: Paste your CSV in the left column. The first row must be the header.
Watch the JSON result appear in the right column.
Click Copy to copy it, or Download to save it as a .json file.
useCase: Data exported from Excel or Google Sheets needs to become JSON for app seed data, a config file, or API test input.
Developers turn a plain spreadsheet into a ready-to-use array of objects, skipping a hand-written parser.

faq.question: Does the first row need to hold column names?
faq.answer: Yes. The first CSV row becomes the header and supplies the keys in the JSON output.

faq.question: What about a comma inside a cell?
faq.answer: Wrap that cell in double quotes, like "text, with a comma". This is standard CSV format and the tool supports it.

faq.question: Are data types like numbers detected automatically?
faq.answer: No. Every value becomes text in the JSON output, since CSV itself carries no type information.

faq.question: Is my data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. The conversion runs in your browser from start to finish.

xml-to-csv.seoTitle: XML to CSV Converter, Free and Upload-Free
xml-to-csv.seoDescription: Convert XML with repeating elements to CSV instantly in your browser. Free, no file upload.
xml-to-csv.schemaDescription: Converts XML with repeating elements to CSV format.
xml-to-csv.title: XML to CSV: convert repeating XML to a CSV table
xml-to-csv.lede: Paste XML with repeating elements. Each element becomes one CSV row.
xml-to-csv.featuresTitle: Why use this XML to CSV tool?

features.title: Automatic pattern detection
features.description: The tool recognizes the row pattern on its own. No manual mapping needed.

features.title: Nested tags become columns
features.description: Tags inside tags turn into separate columns automatically.

features.title: Direct download
features.description: Download the CSV result straight as a file.

xml-to-csv.howToTitle: How to convert XML to CSV
steps: Paste your XML in the left column.
Watch the CSV result appear in the right column.
Click Copy to copy it, or Download to save it as a .csv file.
useCase: A legacy system or API still sends data as XML, but you need to analyze it in Excel or Google Sheets.
Product feeds and sitemaps in XML format become easier to scan once converted to a table.

faq.question: What XML structure can this tool convert?
faq.answer: XML with repeating elements that share a tag name as children of one root, for example several <item> tags inside <items>. Each repeating element becomes one table row.

faq.question: What if my XML has no repeating elements?
faq.answer: The tool treats the whole document as a single row. Each child tag becomes one column.

faq.question: Are XML attributes converted too?
faq.answer: Not yet. The tool reads only the text inside tags. Attributes on a tag, like id="1", aren't supported yet.

faq.question: Is my data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. The conversion runs in your browser from start to finish.

features.title: Automatic validation
features.description: Invalid data triggers an error message first. The tool never shows a broken result.

features.title: Format and minify together
features.description: Clean it up for reading, or compact it for production, in one place.

features.title: Two formats at once
features.description: JSON and XML, the two most common data formats, in a single tool.

data-formatter.howToTitle: How to format JSON or XML
steps: Paste your data in the input column.
Watch the formatted result appear in the right column.
Click Copy or Download to save it.
useCase: An API response arrives as one long line. Checking it gets much easier once it's formatted.
A JSON or XML config file needs a validity check before your app uses it.
The minify feature shrinks a JSON file before you ship it to production, without changing the data.

faq.question: Does this tool validate my JSON/XML too?
faq.answer: Yes. Invalid data triggers an error message explaining the problem, and the tool never shows a broken result.

faq.question: What's the difference between Format and Minify?
faq.answer: Format adds indentation so people can read it easily. Minify strips every space and line break to shrink the file, suited for production.

faq.question: Is minify available for XML too?
faq.answer: Not yet. Minify currently works for JSON mode only. For XML, the tool focuses on indentation.

faq.question: Is my data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. Formatting and validation run in your browser from start to finish.
